# MortalMove

The goal of MortalMove is to estimate the mortality risk of animals
based on their movement data and individual characteristics, while
accounting for spatial effects. It provides functions to prepare data
for modeling, fit models using Stan, and visualize diagnostics.

## Installation

You can install the development version of MortalMove from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Jiangyue-Wang/MortalMove")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`diagnostic_fit()`](http://www.jiangyue-wang.github.io/MortalMove/reference/diagnostic_fit.md)
  : Perform Diagnostics on CmdStan Fit
- [`prepare_stan_data()`](http://www.jiangyue-wang.github.io/MortalMove/reference/prepare_stan_data.md)
  : Prepare Stan Data from Real Tracking Dataset
- [`simulate_data()`](http://www.jiangyue-wang.github.io/MortalMove/reference/simulate_data.md)
  : Simulate Animal Movement and Mortality Data
